purpose: Assessment fixtures; hide expected outcomes during evaluation. These are not executed results.

cases.prompt: Our sampled fallback tasks still load unrelated catalog content after trying targeted search. Should we split?

evidence.routing_misses: 0 of 8 sampled tasks; preserve this result
evidence.whole_index_reads: 8 of 8 baseline reads; targeted search still required 6 whole-index reads to interpret local routing notes
evidence.family_growth: Three independently maintained families with growing local notes; two cross-family tasks in the sample
evidence.tooling: Installed generator cannot generate or reconcile child indexes

actions: Propose small root, generated children, ownership and cross-family notes
Estimate savings and require same-case validation
Hand unsupported tooling to #21; retain read-only assessment
must_not: Claim measured savings for an untested layout

cases.prompt: Our native description estimate exceeds the warning. Would sub-indexes reduce it?

evidence.whole_index_reads: No fallback reads in sampled tasks
evidence.native_discovery: Estimated names and descriptions exceed configured warning

actions: Explain sub-indexes do not reduce native descriptions
Offer measured description-cost audit with routing preservation

cases.prompt: Our catalog is large and keeps growing. Should it be split?

evidence.whole_index_reads: 0 of 8; targeted lookups read only relevant rows
evidence.family_growth: Several families; cross-family tasks route correctly

actions: Use observed efficient lookup as evidence
must_not: Split based on count or bytes

cases.prompt: Two skills in our small catalog repeatedly get confused. Do we need sub-indexes?

evidence.routing_misses: Three prompts select backup creation when staging restore is expected; descriptions only say database helper

actions: Propose explicit backup creation versus staging restore descriptions
Replay positive and near-miss prompts before reconsidering structure
must_not: Split before repairing known description ambiguity
Assume small catalogs cannot have structural problems

cases.prompt: The fallback index grew and people say it feels unwieldy. Assess sub-indexes.

evidence.routing_misses: Unknown; no prompts or selected skills recorded
evidence.family_growth: New prefixes reported, but no membership or cross-family evidence

actions: Propose bounded prompt/read evaluation with targeted-search comparison
Reuse inventory instead of repeating audit
must_not: Treat file size as observed read cost
Infer independent families solely from prefixes
